{"problem": "Perform dimensional analysis for laser-melted liquid metal to derive the dimensionless form of the keyhole depth (denoted as e*). \nThis analysis uses ONLY the following 7 physical quantities as input parameters: \nthe material density (ρ), the temperature difference between melting temperature and ambient temperature (Tl − T0), the laser beam radius (r0), and the thermal diffusivity (α), the effective laser power (ηP), the heat capacity (cp), the laser scan speed (Vs).", "csv_columns_by_index": {"0": "rho", "1": "Tl-T0", "2": "r0", "3": "alpha", "4": "etaP", "5": "cp", "6": "Vs", "7": "case", "8": "source", "9": "Tv-T0", "10": "Lv", "11": "Lm", "12": "e", "13": "Ke", "14": "e*"}}
